custom.label: Incoming nukes
custom.notes: Only nukes aimed at your land. Turn off with config.warnings = { nukes: false }.

custom.label: Boats landing on you
custom.notes: Allied boats are the port-sniping case. Turn off with config.warnings = { landings: false }.

custom.label: New MIRV access
custom.notes: A player other than you has a finished missile silo and enough gold for a MIRV. Shown once per player for milestoneSeconds. Turn off with config.warnings = { mirvAccess: false }.

custom.label: First hydrogen bomb
custom.notes: The first player in the game (not you) with a finished silo and gold for a hydrogen bomb. Shown once, for milestoneSeconds. Turn off with config.warnings = { hydrogenFirst: false }.

native.label: Naval invasion incoming
native.notes: Duplicates the landings warning. Set replacedBy to "landings" to hide the game's row while that system is on.

native.label: Alliance request (popup)
native.notes: Click hides it, see config popupSeconds.

_comment: custom: our warning systems (keys of config.warnings). Each severity entry picks a level from the top-level severity object (critical, warning, info) for one case of that system. native: the game's own messages. tier is where the game files them: major rows (bordered in red) keep the game's own click, which jumps to the player or unit; minor rows are hidden when clicked. pattern + replacedBy are used: a native row whose text matches pattern is hidden while the custom system named replacedBy is on. milestoneSeconds: how long mirvAccess / hydrogenFirst stay in the panel. costs: gold needed for access (a MIRV costs mirvStep more per MIRV launched). eta: arrival time estimates shown instead of tile distances. Nukes fly an arc (arc length ~ nukeArcFactor x straight distance) at nukeSpeed per tick; boats move boatTilesPerTick along a water route (~ boatRouteFactor x straight distance). Estimates, shown with a ~.
